# Zip

**PPL language/runtime 4.00 - host object.**

[Object model and calling conventions](../objects.md) | [API index](index.md)

Factory for ZIP archives. Create returns a writer; Finish publishes the completed archive.

[Behavior, defaults and examples](../zip.md).

## Create

```PPL
Zip.Create(STRING path, [BOOLEAN overwrite]) ZipWriter
```

Static function.

Creates a temporary archive for the destination path. Existing files require overwrite=TRUE; the destination is published by Finish.
